scope: B03-08 A19–A23 special collision, detect, record and first-stop lines 734–847
provenance: Direct pinned source re-review, then historical/canonical reconciliation; separate analytical pass.

groups.interpretation: Inputs special and ordinary lists; no ownership mutation or external acceptance at entry.
Set of ordinary reaction_number only if nonnull, reads field twice for included rows; native hash/equality, not integer coercion.
New special list preserves input order and references; exclude members of ordinary number set; null ordinary excluded from set.
For each surviving special, collect strictly earlier ordinary source_time from original ordinary list, excluding equal source. Fresh list per special.
Max by source_time, first equal maximum in iteration order, null default.
Only if prior nonnull call virtual A22 with exclusive special First end and Blue1 source not_before; true discards special. No alternate prior, no recross. Preserve survivors.
Materialize all surviving special integer ordinal sets and exact trigger events before filtering ordinary. Duplicate ordinals collapse within set; no per-special acceptance mutation.
If no consumed_special leave ordinary list reference unchanged; else construct fresh ordinary list, any short-circuits.

For each ordinary and each surviving special evaluate strict later trigger first; only then integer-convert both ordinary ordinals and intersect. Truthy intersection removes ordinary. Equal trigger alone cannot remove. No special-vs-special resolution.
Return ordinary and special list references; original zone records unmodified locally; provider calls may change caches.
Build valid states then ordinary list; generate special candidates only after ordinary succeeds. Resolve collision once via virtual A19; failure propagates.

Concatenate ordinary then special, stable ascending sort source_time then exact trigger_event_time. Equal keys retain ordinary before special and original within-list order. No public visibility/lifecycle gate.
Forward kwargs directly to AZone constructor, no normalization or validation beyond native constructor; live override may reuse records.
First-stop cycle test uses supplied end and optional not_before; not a universal stop query. Docstring rejects later recross as new cycle.
Read candles[zone.source_index].index, int then plus one, not source_index+1; if >= len return false, no lower bound check, negative indexing remains native.
Read zone.price then start candle timestamp, invoke virtual A07 from next stored-index position to exclusive end. Lower/main fallback contract A07 applies.
Null first hit false; otherwise not_before null short-circuits, else exact event>=bound. First hit before bound false, no second search.
Construct base detector and immediately call detect, no persistent A history at helper; underlying chronology/index provider can retain cache.
